title: To Compare the Efficacy of I.V 200 mg Iron Sucrose and 500 mg Iron Sucrose to Treat Anemia in Pregnancy
brief_summary: This study is aimed to compare the efficacy of 2 doses of iron sucrose given intravenously - 200 mg versus 500 mg.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Singleton pregnancy
* Iron deficiency anemia
* Intolerance or low compliance for oral iron

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known allergy for iron supplements
* Anemia not due to iron deficiency
* Acute infection
* Liver failure or viral hepatitis
* Thalassemia or hemoglobinopathies
* Asthma
* Multiple pregnancy
